issues.description: The problem statement uses a snake_case method name `get_total_number_of_students()` in the textual task description, while the UML, template comments, and the reference solution use the camelCase Java-style name `getTotalNumberOfStudents()`. This inconsistent identifier naming for the same method can confuse students about the exact method name they should implement in Java.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across all artifacts. Update the textual task in problem_statement.md to use the Java-style camelCase name `getTotalNumberOfStudents()` (preferred), or alternatively change the UML/template/solution to match the snake_case name. Prefer using `getTotalNumberOfStudents()` to follow Java naming conventions and avoid student confusion.
